nova.description: A confident, friendly ten-year-old girl with a bright, clear, medium-high voice. Warm and cheerful, like the host of a kids' cartoon show, speaking at a lively, natural pace

curly.description: A cheeky, giggly eight-year-old girl with a very high, slightly squeaky, raspy cartoon voice. Mischievous and excited, speaking fast and playfully

lines.text: Hi! I'm Nova, the new leader of this channel!
And I'm her best friend! I do all the hard work.
Okay. I bring all the snacks.
On this channel, we tell you fun stories.
With cats! And robots! And giant cookies!
So follow us, and see you in the next video!
